description:
The name says it all. Designed by track racers, for track racers. Built with oversize tubing and an integrated ZS head tube.Custom steel frame.
BIG ASS TRACK BIKE: The name says it all.
TIG welded in Portland, Oregon, from venerable Columbus steel tubing, this lightweight steel track racing machine is built for speed. Winner of numerous Oregon and National Championship titles, the BAT Bike maximizes power transfer from rider to rubber, providing quick accelleration and responsive handling at speed.
SPECS:
Columbus Zona oversize tube set.
Integrated Zero Stack head tube.
Slightly sloping top tube.
Frame price includes single color powder coat. Many colors available.
Frameset price includes removable aluminum seatpost collar, headset, and fork.
Optional frameset with steel Big Ass Track fork includes single color powder coat.
Optional frameset with carbon track fork includes single color wet paint.
Available as a complete bike with custom component build kit.
SIZES: This bike is available only as a custom build, built to fit your specific geometry.
